§15.3 diagram label-overlap fix. Yaniv inspected the preview and flagged that some text sits ON the drawing in the arch-sections diagram (page 39), asking whether the SSOT forbids it and whether it happens elsewhere. It does: SSOT §15.3 requires labels/numbers/units not to overlap the lines. Root cause found by a live geometric audit of all 46 pages: the browser-qa labelSafety gate only measured text.label inside svg.cone-svg/axial-svg/orientation-cone, so EVERY expansion-diagram label (plain <text>, no .label class) shipped unchecked for stroke overlap. The audit found 5 real glyph-on-stroke overlaps in measurement diagrams: page 7 net 'קודקוד', page 21 ratio cylinder 'r' and cone 'h'/'r', page 39 arch-sections 'החתך'+'6 ס״מ', page 45 right-triangle '6 ס״מ' (comic-scene speech/part labels on page 2 are stylised illustration, not measurable diagrams, and are intentionally out of §15.3 scope). Fix: (1) hardened browser-qa with a new labelOverlap gate (SSOT §15.3) covering every measurement-diagram SVG class and every <text>, failing when a stroke centreline passes through a label's glyph area (bbox inset toward the ink); (2) repositioned the 7 overlapping labels in app.js off the strokes (net 'קודקוד' to the left of the apex; ratio 'r' labels to the radius-line ends and cone 'h' beside the axis; arch 'החתך' right of the cross-section ellipse with a shortened leader and '6 ס״מ' below the base; right-triangle '6 ס״מ' left of the leg). Verified: live geometric audit 0 overlaps / 0 clips across 46 pages; per-page visual confirmation of pages 7/21/39/45 and near-miss 26/37; node browser-qa.mjs PASS (46 pages, containment, labelClip, labelSafety, labelOverlap all green), npm run qa PASS.
